metrics.label: Noncurrent loans / loans
metrics.row_label: Percent of Loans and Leases Noncurrent

metrics.label: Net charge-off rate
metrics.row_label: Quarterly Net Charge-Offs to Loans and Leases

metrics.label: Allowance / noncurrent loans
metrics.row_label: Loss Allowance to Noncurrent Loans and Leases (Coverage Ratio)

metrics.label: Return on assets
metrics.definition: Published annualized quarterly return on average assets; not net income divided by quarter-end assets.

metrics.label: Bank equity / assets
metrics.definition: Bank equity capital excluding noncontrolling interests as a percentage of assets; not a regulatory capital ratio.

metrics.label: Deposits
metrics.definition: FDIC-reported aggregate domestic and foreign-office deposits.

context.label: Reporting institutions

coverage.note: Published history from this workbook edition, not original-release vintages. Historical component mismatches are retained explicitly; no ratios are reconstructed or repaired.

validation.scope: Current, prior-quarter and year-ago source-component ratios; full history checked with exceptions retained.

method_note: Published aggregate ratios, not unweighted institution averages. Quarterly ROA and charge-off ratios are already annualized using average-period denominators. Percent values are percentage points; monetary values are USD millions. No regulatory capital ratios or composite health score.
